name: kaggleds-corpus-task-based-search-bench
description: A task-based search / retrieval benchmark built from a Kaggle dataset corpus intended to evaluate search systems' ability to find relevant Kaggle tasks given a query. It measures retrieval and ranking quality for task-oriented queries and is aimed at improving task discovery and search relevance in data-science/code-related corpora. Useful for evaluating IR models and rerankers in a domain-specific setting.
reputation: A niche benchmark with modest adoption among researchers focused on task-based or domain-specific information retrieval.
